locator.name: the tray's part of the frame channel > drops a partial, non-finite or non-positive pair and keeps the vertical edge

proves.facet: Eight unusable pairs - one side only, zero, negative, NaN, infinite, a string and null - each store the vertical-only measured edge, so a rejected extent never rejects the report.

locator.name: the tray's part of the frame channel > takes the box's own left and width as a pair

proves.facet: An accepted finite pair with a positive width reaches the stored measured edge unchanged: left 240 and width 620 as posted.

locator.name: the tray's part of the frame channel > keeps a composer message without the pair valid

proves.facet: A composer message that carries only the vertical edge parses and stores as a measured box, which is the older plug-in's admissible shape.
